metadata.name: hybrid_vault
metadata.description: Track A (SPL-404) token<->NFT vault: VRF-selected blind capture/re-roll, exact unwrap, fixed 2% fee to an immutable fee account. Bound 1:1 to a hybrid_launch LaunchConfig. Devnet/localnet only. NOT AUDITED.

instructions.name: buyback
docs: Spend SOL on the tax PDA to buy this launch's tokens at the locked price.
Bought tokens accrue to project NFT holders only.

instructions.name: claim_tax
docs: Pay the next frozen NFT its exact share. The caller cannot choose the NFT,
the amount, or the destination. If no round is open, this pays nothing.

instructions.name: commit_raffle
docs: Commit the pinned Switchboard account. The program picks the oracle. No second try after a reveal.

accounts.name: user_token
docs: The user's token account for the capture refund of N (principal only).

instructions.name: expire_requests
docs: M-04 batch expire: up to MAX_EXPIRE_PER_CALL consecutive queue heads in one instruction
(7 remaining accounts per request; see instructions/expire.rs).

instructions.name: harvest_tax
docs: Move withheld transfer tax into the program treasury and accrue it per project NFT.

instructions.name: init_permanent_vault
docs: Mode 3. Bind a permanent vault to a `BurnLaunchConfig`. No token vault, no release.

instructions.name: init_raffle_randomness
docs: Create a Switchboard randomness account whose authority is this vault's PDA.

instructions.name: init_raffle_vault
docs: Mode 5. Bind a raffle vault to a Mode 5 tax launch and pin its Switchboard queue.

instructions.name: init_token22_vault
docs: Mode 4. Bind a tax vault to a Token-2022 launch. Creates the project collection.
Wrap locks tokens; it does not burn them.

docs: graduation fund (drained pre-fund lamports land here). `mut` only for that drain.

accounts.name: pool

instructions.name: open_permanent_vault
docs: Mode 3. Permissionless, one-way. Opens wrapping once graduation is verified.

accounts.name: launch_config

accounts.name: fee_recipient
docs: transfer (F-06 / M-05). Not the LaunchConfig copy, so a wallet rotation never strands old launches.

accounts.name: launch_config
docs: Immutable economics (M-01); re-validated in config::econ.

accounts.name: vault_tokens
docs: Read-only: solvency is asserted after the hand-in (no tokens move on a re-roll).

instructions.name: reveal_raffle
docs: Submit the oracle reveal. The value is stored. It cannot be replaced.

instructions.name: settle_raffle
docs: Pay the snapshotted owner of the winning NFT the whole pot.

accounts.name: settler
docs: Anyone (crank). Pays nothing but the tx fee.

accounts.name: randomness

instructions.name: snapshot_raffle
docs: Record the current owner of the next frozen NFT. Must finish before the draw is requested.

instructions.name: wrap_permanent
docs: Mode 3 wrap. Burns exactly `ratio` tokens and mints the next NFT. Irreversible.

instructions.name: wrap_token22
docs: Mode 4. Lock `ratio` tokens and mint the next project NFT. Supply does not change.

types.name: BurnLaunchConfig
docs: Immutable Mode 3 record: classic SPL, fixed ratio, known collection, burn-on-wrap.
Same PDA seeds as [`LaunchConfig`] (`["launch_config", mint]`), different account type. Mode 2's
vault loads only `LaunchConfig`, so this mint cannot be wrapped reversibly and cannot be released.
There is no instruction that modifies or closes it.

fields.name: mint_authority_bump
docs: 0 when DBC created the mint (`register_burn_dbc`). The native path stores the mint-authority bump.

fields.name: launch_mode
docs: Always [`crate::LAUNCH_MODE_BURN`].

fields.name: creator
docs: Who paid. Holds no powers.

fields.name: mint
docs: Classic SPL Token mint; mint + freeze authority are `None`.

fields.name: launch_destination
docs: Native: ATA(launch_vault, mint). DBC: the pool's base vault.

fields.name: launch_vault
docs: Native: PDA `["launch_vault", mint, launch_config]`. DBC: DBC's pool authority.

fields.name: ratio_whole_tokens
docs: Whole tokens per NFT (one of ALLOWED_RATIOS). Fixed at creation.

fields.name: ratio_base
docs: ratio_whole_tokens * 10^decimals.

fields.name: collection_size
docs: Number of NFTs in the collection. Fixed at creation.

fields.name: max_tokens_in_nft_form
docs: collection_size * ratio_base (<= total_supply_base).

fields.name: fee_lamports
docs: Flat SOL fee charged on wrap. Exact tier for the ratio. No release fee exists.

fields.name: fee_recipient
docs: PLATFORM_FEE_RECIPIENT at launch. The only fee destination.

fields.name: graduation_slice_pct
docs: Always 0 (lazy mint). Kept so the economics match the Mode 2 derivation.

fields.name: dbc_config
docs: Default for native `launch_burn`. Allowlisted config for `register_burn_dbc`.

fields.name: dbc_pool
docs: Default for native `launch_burn` (the vault can never open). The DBC pool otherwise.

fields.name: sb_queue
docs: Switchboard On-Demand queue every randomness account must use.

types.name: LaunchConfig
docs: Immutable launch record for one Track A mint. PDA `["launch_config", mint]`.
There is NO instruction that modifies or closes this account: ratio,
collection size, SOL fees, fee recipient and mint are fixed at launch
(Stonk.fun lesson: no mutable economics after launch).

fields.name: creator
docs: Who paid for the launch. Holds no powers.

fields.name: mint
docs: Classic SPL Token mint; mint + freeze authority are `None`.

fields.name: launch_destination
docs: ATA(launch_vault, mint): received the full supply. Owned by the PDA below;
no instruction can move tokens out of it (distribution mechanism TBD).

fields.name: launch_vault
docs: PDA `["launch_vault", mint, launch_config]` owning `launch_destination`.

fields.name: ratio_whole_tokens
docs: Whole tokens per NFT (one of ALLOWED_RATIOS).

fields.name: ratio_base
docs: ratio_whole_tokens * 10^decimals.

fields.name: collection_size
docs: Number of NFTs in the collection.

fields.name: max_tokens_in_nft_form
docs: collection_size * ratio_base (<= total_supply_base).

fields.name: fee_lamports
docs: The flat SOL fee (lamports) charged on EVERY capture, release and re-roll, fixed forever
(ADR-013) = fee_for_ratio(ratio_whole_tokens) at launch; <= MAX_FEE_LAMPORTS (0.01 SOL).
There is no token fee.

fields.name: fee_recipient
docs: PLATFORM_FEE_RECIPIENT at launch time: the only address any fee can reach (F-06 / M-05).

fields.name: graduation_threshold_lamports
docs: Graduation threshold (lamports raised; DBC migration threshold). `graduation_slice_pct` is
always 0 since lazy minting (ADR-016); the field stays for the append-only layout.

fields.name: dbc_config
docs: DBC config of the curve (`register_dbc_launch`); default for native `launch` (never opens).

fields.name: dbc_pool
docs: DBC virtual pool of the curve. `hybrid_vault::graduation::verify` only accepts this pool, and
only once DBC reports it migrated. Default for native `launch` => the vault can never open.

types.name: LeafPreimage
docs: Leaf preimage supplied by the settler for a lazy mint (graduation-design §5.1).

fields.name: uri
docs: Content-addressed URI of the metadata JSON; becomes the asset's on-chain URI verbatim.

types.name: MintArgs
docs: Settle's lazy-mint arguments: the committed leaf preimage for the picked index and its proof.

types.name: PermanentVault
docs: One Mode 3 vault per `BurnLaunchConfig`. PDA `["vault", launch_config]`.
Not a [`Vault`]. Mode 2 instructions cannot load it, and this mode has no release, re-roll, or
expire. The next NFT index is `minted_count` (not a VRF draw): burn and mint are one instruction,
so a failed reveal cannot destroy tokens that there is no release instruction to return.

fields.name: launch_mode
docs: Always `hybrid_launch::LAUNCH_MODE_BURN`.

fields.name: total_burned_base
docs: Tokens burned by wraps. Not a balance anyone can withdraw.

types.name: RaffleSeat
docs: Owner of one NFT at the moment the raffle list was frozen. Written before randomness exists.

types.name: RandLock
docs: Binds a Switchboard randomness account to one pending request so no other request can commit it
while this one is pending. PDA `["rand_lock", randomness]`.

types.name: Request
docs: One pending capture or re-roll. PDA `["request", vault, seq_le]`. Closed (rent to `user`) only
by settle, or by the principal-only expire after MAX_RECOMMITS unrevealed re-commits. There is
no cancel instruction and the fees are never refunded.

fields.name: seed_slot
docs: Switchboard seed slot of the vault's latest commit for this request.

fields.name: deadline_slot
docs: After this slot, if still unrevealed, anyone may re-commit (REVEAL_TIMEOUT_SLOTS).

fields.name: commits
docs: Number of commits so far (1 + re-commits), at most 1 + MAX_RECOMMITS.

fields.name: oracles
docs: Oracle of each commit; a re-commit must use an oracle not used before for this request.

fields.name: revealed
docs: Set by `reveal_randomness`: the value is recorded once and never changes (settle reads it).

fields.name: handed_in_index
docs: Asset index handed in for a re-roll, NO_HANDED_IN for a capture.

fields.name: mint_escrow_lamports
docs: Lazy-mint escrow amount deposited at request (ADR-016); the lamports sit in the separate
`["mint_escrow", vault, seq]` PDA, not in this account.

types.name: RevealArgs
docs: Reveal args (Switchboard `RandomnessRevealInstructionArgs`).

types.name: T22BurnLaunchConfig
docs: Immutable Mode 4 record: Token-2022 with a transfer tax, fixed at launch.
Same PDA seeds as [`LaunchConfig`], different account type. The tax rate cannot be changed
(`transfer_fee_config_authority` is None). Withheld tokens withdraw only to the vault program's
tax PDA, which pays them to holders of this launch's NFTs. This mode does not burn.

fields.name: launch_mode
docs: Always [`crate::LAUNCH_MODE_TOKEN22`].

fields.name: tax_bps
docs: Transfer-tax rate in basis points. Chosen at launch. Not updatable.

fields.name: tax_authority
docs: `hybrid_vault` PDA `["tax_authority", mint]`. The only withdraw-withheld authority.

fields.name: buyback_lamports_per_whole
docs: Lamports of SOL per whole token. Chosen at launch. Not updatable.

types.name: TaxVault
docs: Mode 4 vault. Not a [`Vault`] and not a [`PermanentVault`].
Wrap locks `ratio` tokens (it does not burn them) and mints the next project NFT.
Transfer-tax withheld by Token-2022 is withdrawn by `tax_authority` and paid only to
the current owner of one of this collection's NFTs. There is no burn and no unwrap.

fields.name: launch_mode
docs: Always `hybrid_launch::LAUNCH_MODE_TOKEN22`.

fields.name: collection_size
docs: Fixed at init. Caps how many NFTs can exist. Not used to reserve rewards.

fields.name: payout_cursor
docs: Next NFT index the program will pay. Callers cannot choose a different one.

fields.name: round_minted
docs: How many NFTs were already minted when this round was frozen.

fields.name: round_share
docs: Exact tokens each of those NFTs is paid. Zero when no round is open.

fields.name: round_open
docs: 1 while a round is frozen. Nobody can change the set or the share while this is set.

fields.name: credited_base
docs: Tokens assigned to minted NFTs. Claims cannot exceed this.

fields.name: paid_base
docs: Tokens already paid to holders of minted NFTs.

fields.name: pending_base
docs: Arrived tokens not yet assigned because the pot is under the market-cap tier,
no NFT exists yet, or the split left rounding dust.

fields.name: buyback_lamports_per_whole
docs: Locked at init from the launch. Values the pot and the market cap. Not updatable.

fields.name: total_supply_base
docs: Locked at init. 1_000_000_000 * 10^decimals.

fields.name: kind
docs: `KIND_SPLIT` (Mode 4) or `KIND_RAFFLE` (Mode 5). Fixed at init.

fields.name: raffle_phase
docs: Raffle only. Idle until a pot crosses the tier, then snapshot, commit, reveal.

fields.name: sb_queue
docs: Pinned Switchboard queue. Default for a split vault.

fields.name: round_id
docs: Increments when a raffle round opens, before any seat is written.

fields.name: round_pot
docs: Whole pot for the open raffle round. Zero for a split round.

types.name: Vault
docs: One vault per hybrid_launch LaunchConfig. PDA `["vault", launch_config]`; every token account,
the collection and every asset are seeded by this vault key (never by an authority alone, A-06).
Economics (ratio, N, SOL fees, fee recipient) are READ from the immutable LaunchConfig on every
use (M-01); the vault keeps no copies. No instruction changes them.

fields.name: open
docs: Converting is closed until `open_vault` (graduation verified + collection fully minted). One-way.

fields.name: launch_config
docs: The immutable hybrid_launch LaunchConfig. Ratio, N, mint, SOL fees and fee recipient are READ
FROM IT on every use (audit M-01: no local copies).

fields.name: sb_queue
docs: Switchboard queue pinned at init; every randomness account must use it.

fields.name: trait_root
docs: Leaf-v2 Merkle root (merkle.rs) and the trait schema hash, committed at init.

fields.name: assets_outside
docs: NFTs owned by users (not in pool/incoming, not held as a re-roll hand-in).

fields.name: next_seq
docs: Next request sequence number / next request that may be settled or expired (FIFO head).

fields.name: total_fee_lamports
docs: Capture + re-roll SOL fees paid directly to the fee recipient.
